content.user_title: Debug Code with Root Cause Analysis
content.value_statement: Debugging complex failures can waste time when symptoms hide the cause. This skill guides structured diagnosis, minimal fixes, and practical verification.
actual_capabilities: Captures error messages, stack traces, and reproduction steps before diagnosis.
Guides hypothesis-driven analysis of logs, recent changes, and failing behavior.
Helps isolate likely failure locations and explain supporting evidence.
Recommends minimal code fixes focused on the underlying cause.
Defines verification steps and prevention recommendations after a fix.
limitations: Does not replace running tests or validating changes in the target environment.
Requires users to provide relevant errors, logs, context, or reproduction steps.
Does not guarantee fixes for missing dependencies, unavailable services, or hidden infrastructure issues.
May need domain expertise for specialized systems, security bugs, or production incidents.

use_cases.title: Resolve Failing Tests
use_cases.description: Investigate test output, identify the likely cause, and define a focused fix with verification steps.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Runtime Errors
use_cases.description: Use stack traces, logs, and recent changes to locate failure points in an application workflow.

use_cases.title: Review Debugging Plans
use_cases.description: Create a structured investigation checklist before changing code in a shared project.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Debugging Session
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner diagnosis with one visible error.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the debugger skill. I have this error: [paste error]. Ask for any missing context, then guide me through the first diagnosis steps.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a Test Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the debugger skill to analyze this failing test output: [paste output]. Identify the most likely root cause and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Debugging Hypotheses
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced issue with several possible causes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the debugger skill to compare possible causes for this behavior: [describe behavior]. Rank hypotheses by evidence and suggest focused checks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Minimal Fix
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced repair planning after evidence is collected.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the debugger skill. Given this diagnosis and evidence: [paste summary]. Propose a minimal fix, tests, and prevention recommendations.

output_examples.input: A user reports that a page crashes after submitting a form.
output: Root cause candidate: form data may be missing a required field before submission handling.
Evidence to collect: browser console error, server log entry, request payload, and recent form changes.
Verification: reproduce the submission, apply the smallest validation fix, and retest success and failure paths.

output_examples.input: A unit test passed yesterday but fails after recent changes.
output: Start with the exact assertion failure and the commit range since the last passing run.
Check whether changed setup data, mocks, or expected outputs explain the mismatch.
Confirm the fix by running the targeted test first, then the related test group.

output_examples.input: An API sometimes returns a timeout in staging.
output: Treat the issue as intermittent until logs show a stable trigger.
Compare slow and successful requests by endpoint, payload size, dependency latency, and deployment timing.
Verify with repeated staging runs and monitoring data before promoting the fix.

best_practices: Provide the exact error message, stack trace, environment, and recent changes before asking for a fix.
Test one hypothesis at a time so evidence remains clear and actionable.
Verify the final fix with targeted tests and a prevention note.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad rewrites before the root cause is understood.
Do not ignore reproduction steps or environment differences when debugging intermittent behavior.
Do not stop after suppressing an error without checking the underlying failure path.

faq.question: What kind of debugging does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports errors, failing tests, unexpected behavior, and structured root cause analysis for development workflows.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides debugging guidance. Any command execution depends on the host assistant and user permissions.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the error message, stack trace, reproduction steps, environment, and recent code changes.

faq.question: Can it fix production incidents?
faq.answer: It can help structure investigation, but production incidents still require environment access, monitoring data, and operational judgment.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: How does it help prevent repeat bugs?
faq.answer: It asks for prevention recommendations after the fix, such as better tests, clearer validation, or improved logging.
